page_title: HOF 1-3 DOR | Hoffenheim v Dortmund 29/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' 1 - 3 Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) bursts into the box after a great solo run and gets one-on-one with the keeper, who he neatly side steps and rolls the ball into an empty net. Wonderful effort!
90+5' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+3' Marius Wolf (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+2' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) is caught offside!
90+1' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) commits a foul during an attacking move.
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Andrej Kramaric walks off the pitch to be replaced by Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim).
86' Although Marco Reus (Dortmund) is just on the bench, Florian Badstubner has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
85' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul.
84' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. Julian Justvan (Hoffenheim) replaces Maximilian Beier.
84' A substitution has been made. John Anthony Brooks is replaced by Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim).
83' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) takes a short corner kick.

82' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save. Good work from Dortmund as they win a corner.
82' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
80' Edin Terzic decides to make a substitution. Donyell Malen will be replaced by Niklas Sule (Dortmund).
80' Substitution. Marius Wolf (Dortmund) has come on for Marco Reus.
80' Here is a change. Niclas Fullkrug is going off and Edin Terzic gives the last tactical orders to Sebastien Haller (Dortmund).
78' The ball is cleared after Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Dortmund will have a throw-in.
75' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way wide of the right-hand post.
75' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
74' Marco Reus (Dortmund) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
73' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) nicely brought down the pass, but his long-range effort was wild and went well wide of the right post.
71' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) receives a second yellow card and is sent off.
70' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
69' Substitution. Felix Nmecha makes way for Emre Can (Dortmund).
68' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to substitute Robert Skov and he is replaced by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim).
68' Substitution. Grischa Promel will be replaced by Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim).
68' He should have scored! Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
67' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
65' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Florian Badstubner who sees an offensive foul.
64' The substitution is prepared. Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Julian Brandt.
63' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes it short.
62' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
61' Kevin Vogt (Hoffenheim) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
60' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
58' Marco Reus (Dortmund) is penalised for a foul. Florian Badstubner had a clear view and blows his whistle.
55' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
54' A long pass, executed by Donyell Malen (Dortmund), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
52' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

52' This should have been a goal! Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) takes a mid-range free kick and his effort flies straight as an arrow, but crashes against the crossbar. The keeper only turned his head and stared at the ball.

50' Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Hoffenheim are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
50' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

48' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Gregor Kobel shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
48' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
48' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
47' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' 1 - 2 Goal! 1:2. Marco Reus (Dortmund) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
45+2' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' The main referee, Florian Badstubner, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) is given a yellow card for dissent.
40' Dangerous play by Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund). Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
38' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
37' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar.
36' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul. Hoffenheim have a free kick from a promising distance.
36' A cross into the box from Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) is cleared.
35' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

35' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
33' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
31' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
30' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
28' What a miss! The corner finds Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar.
27' Kevin Vogt (Hoffenheim) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

27' A neat pass is well received by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot. Hoffenheim get a corner.
25' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Gregor Kobel no chance!
25' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is going to take the penalty!
25' It’s a PENALTY to Hoffenheim after the VAR review!
24' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Hoffenheim! Let's see what he decides.
23' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Badstubner had an easy-decision to make.

23' Mats Hummels (Dortmund) brings his opponent down. Florian Badstubner has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Hoffenheim win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
22' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
22' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Dortmund will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
21' A pass from Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) is intercepted by Gregor Kobel and the move breaks down.
20' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
18' 0 - 1 Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
17' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
15' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
14' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Oliver Baumann, who smothers the ball.
13' The ball is cleared after Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
12' Marco Reus (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' The game is interrupted. Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
10' Rough tackle by Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Dortmund.
7' John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and Florian Badstubner immediately signals a free kick.
6' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Oliver Baumann intercepts the ball.
4' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
2' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
